title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) CRIME IN INDIA-1999 1.17.2 Out of 667 Police Districts (including Railway Police Districts) in India during 1999, as many as 89 districts registered more than 5,000 cognizable IPC crimes. Out of the above 10 Police districts, viz., Hyderabad city in Andhra Pradesh, Ahmedabad Commissionerate in Gujarat, Bangalore Commissionerate in Karnataka, Eranakulam in Kerala, Bhopal, Indore in Madhya Pradesh, Mumbai in Maharashtra, Jaipur in Rajasthan, Calcutta Commissionerate in West Bengal and South District in UT of Delhi registered more than 10,000 cognizable IPC crimes each. Of the above 10 districts, Mumbai Commissionerate registered the highest IPC cases(29,406) during the year, amongst all the Police districts in India.
